en.headline: Baby Basic recalls pasta and congee products after rice weevil reports
en.dek: The local baby-food maker has withdrawn several instant products from shelves as a precaution and suspended production of three pasta varieties; government tests have not confirmed a health risk.
body: Hong Kong baby-food producer Baby Basic on Wednesday voluntarily recalled several products after parents and online users raised concerns that some items might contain rice weevils.

The recall covers the ‘instant baby congee – konbu salmon’ with an expiry date of 22 June 2027, together with three flavours of ‘instant rice-shaped pasta’: salmon and cream, tomato and chicken, and vegetable and beef. Production of the three pasta varieties has been suspended. The company said the action followed a report involving the vegetable-and-beef pasta.

Baby Basic, founded in 2015, said the recall is a precautionary step to reassure parents. It stated that government food-safety tests had not confirmed any health risks. Customers who bought the affected products may seek refunds via the company’s hotline or WhatsApp.

zh.headline: 寶寶百味回收米形麵及粥品 疑有穀牛
zh.dek: 本地嬰幼兒食品商周三自願下架多款即食產品並暫停三款米形麵生產，作為預防措施；政府化驗未證實健康風險。
body: 香港嬰幼兒食品商寶寶百味周三表示，因應家長及網上用戶關注部分產品可能含有穀牛，自願回收多款產品。
回收範圍包括到期日為2027年6月22日的「即食米米粥（昆布三文魚）」，以及三款「即食米形麵」：白汁三文魚、蕃茄雞肉及蔬菜牛肉。三款米形麵已暫停生產。公司指行動源於一宗涉及蔬菜牛肉口味的報告。
成立於2015年的寶寶百味表示，今次回收屬預防措施，以釋除家長疑慮，並指政府食物安全測試未證實任何健康風險。已購買受影響產品的顧客可經熱線或WhatsApp申請退款。
